title: Swinney backs ‘sham’ climate assessments on North Sea fossil fuel
description: JOHN SWINNEY has renewed his faith in North Sea oil and gas assessments branded a “sham” by climate campaigners today. Scotland’s First Minister made the remarks after UK Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh travelled to Aberdeen on Thursday to meet representatives of the offshore industry amid an ongoing consultation on whether to grant licences to exploit the enormous Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas fields.

title: Ancient statues discovered during restoration of Karachi's Lea Market
description: Karachi Mayor Murtaza Wahab said that evidence of archaeological significance was uncovered during the restoration work in the city's Old City Area.
